file: 05- Managing Projects using The PRINCE2 Approach.docx
title: Managing Projects using The PRINCE2 Approach
overview: This course aims to equip participants with a thorough understanding of PRINCE2 principles, methodologies, processes, and themes essential for successful project management. It also prepares participants for the PRINCE2 certification exams at both the foundation and practitioner levels through practical exercises and case studies
audience: Project professionals including project managers, Project Management Office (PMO) staff, and project team members. This course offers 30 Professional Development Units (PDUs).
methodology: The course employs a blend of interactive techniques, including brief presentations by both the consultant and participants, PRINCE2 exam sample questions, and scenario-based exercises. It also features group activities and case studies followed by plenary discussions.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify and understand PRINCE2 principles, themes, and processes.
Apply PRINCE2 methodologies to initiate and manage projects effectively.
Define the project’s accountability structure and responsibilities.
Assess project viability and develop strategies for product delivery.
Ensure products meet quality standards and manage project uncertainties.
Implement and manage approved changes while controlling deviations.
Plan and manage product delivery and stage boundaries.
Close projects in accordance with PRINCE2 principles.
